faq.q: How much does J.A. Davis & Associates charge?
faq.a: J.A. Davis & Associates publishes a contingency fee, which means the fee is a share of what the case recovers and there is nothing to pay if it recovers nothing. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does J.A. Davis & Associates offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. J.A. Davis & Associates publishes a free initial consultation. It publishes material in Spanish.

faq.q: Where does J.A. Davis & Associates have offices?
faq.a: J.A. Davis & Associates publishes one office, in San Antonio. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at J.A. Davis & Associates?
faq.a: J.A. Davis & Associates names three attorneys on its own site, and each is listed on this profile with the page we read them from. They have not been checked against a state register: Texas does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.
